title: Architect report: end-of-Phase 1 architecture update
summary: ARCHITECTURE.md now describes what was built in T-001a to T-001d, checked against the code rather than the plan. It adds the security decisions from review, the deviations from the plan, an unverified-Docker warning with a checklist, a follow-up backlog and Phase 2 starting points. No application code, tests or contract were changed.

items.label: Planned to built.
items.text: Components, patterns, data model and personas now name real files. The nine Phase 1 tables are marked built in migration 0001 (backend/migrations/versions/0001_initial_schema.py); invoice_line_items and payment_links stay 'later'. The only remaining 'planned' section is the AWS layout.

items.label: Stack versions.
items.text: Installed versions checked against both lockfiles; all match the table.

items.label: New section 9: security decisions.
items.text: Secret guard, required APP_ENV, seed guard, NUL rejection, safeRedirect, CSP generation and API_BASE_URL host rules, photo URL signing.

items.label: Local run.
items.text: The no-Docker path (scripts/dev.sh) is marked verified. Docker is marked KNOWN UNVERIFIED, with a 7-step checklist for when make up fails.

items.label: New sections 14 and 15.
items.text: Follow-up backlog (B1 to B8) and Phase 2 starting points for the Expo painter app.

blocks.heading: Build status
rows: Built and verified: lint, pytest, Vitest and Playwright pass
Written and checked with 'docker compose config' only. Never built or run (no Docker daemon in the build workspace)

blocks.heading: Deviations from the plan
rows: react-router's bundled warning text contains https://github.com/ungap/url-search-params. and the exact-string allowlist would reject it. Keep the hook. To use useSearchParams later, add that string to spec T-000 7.1, T-001a scenario 5 and web/scripts/dist-origins.mjs
Small app; still plain CSS with system fonts
Interface sits next to the client Adapter
Filters and totals run in SQL; a test checks they agree with the pure functions
Adds --static, seed, psql and port variables
e2e runs against the production build
Required, no default (compose defaults it to local)

items.label: Secret guard.
items.text: When APP_ENV is not local or test, JWT_SECRET and PHOTO_URL_SECRET must be set explicitly. They are rejected if they are dev defaults, start with dev-only- (any case), have surrounding whitespace, or are equal to each other (ignoring case). Production also refuses demo accounts and FIXED_NOW.

items.label: APP_ENV.
items.text: Required, with no default; must be exactly local, test, staging or production.

items.label: Seed guard.
items.text: The seed runs only when APP_ENV is local or test, so staging has no demo data. A staging demo dataset needs an explicit decision.

items.label: NUL characters.
items.text: Rejected with 422 in the login fields and the q search parameter.

items.label: safeRedirect.
items.text: Only same-origin paths are accepted. Control characters, backslashes, // and /login targets are refused.

items.label: CSP.
items.text: Generated by web/nginx/40-jobproof-config.sh, with strict API_BASE_URL host rules. Covered by the config-script unit test and e2e/tests/csp.spec.ts.

items.label: Demo accounts endpoint.
items.text: Returns 404 unless DEMO_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is set. The config refuses it when APP_ENV is production.

invoice customer = job customer is enforced only by the seed and the app; option: a composite FK

items.label: Overrides.
items.text: js-yaml ^4.3.2 (installed 4.3.2) and minimatch ^11.0.1 (installed 11.0.5). Remove each once its parents' own ranges resolve to a patched version; check weekly, at the latest by 2027-02-01.

items.label: typescript 7.
items.text: Deferral still holds: typescript-eslint 8.72.1 does not support it.

items.label: Reuse from shared/.
items.text: Generated client, the Adapter, ApiError, query keys, auth hooks and formatters. The shared package has no DOM access.

items.label: Platform-specific.
items.text: A TokenStore over expo-secure-store (the interface already allows async methods), navigation and camera capture.

items.label: Endpoints needed.
items.text: The painter's own jobs, draft report with checklist, photo upload through an S3PhotoStore with presigned URLs (MinIO locally), and report submission. Ownership rules make the per-persona Policy worth introducing.
